fixture: Bind BonesCB VS0 atbuffer0 full12288B, PerFrameVertexCB at1 full560B, LocalsVertex at9 full144B. Bones are256*48B, each three contiguous float4 rows used as row-dot transforms. Set all256 bones identity, all four vertex joint indices0 and weights[1,0,0,0]. Each bone is loaded unconditionally; zero weights do not waive index validity. No separate model/world/inverseBind buffer argument exists.

Attributes are0position float3,1weights float4,2normal float3,7joints uint4,8uv float2. Use owned storage/vertexdescriptor with no uniformslotcollision, e.g.vertexbuffer20 and synthetic64Bstride pos0/weights12/normal28/joints40/uv56. This packing is not native Leona layout evidence.

VS frame used fields mProj@0 and camera.xyz@64. FOW params@304 remain declared but are not read inVS0. Locals vFresnel@0, UVrows@16, unusedmultUV@64, kColorFactor@112, depthPush@128. Initialize declared padding. mProj consists four row float4 dot products, not assume hostcolumn-majorrawmatrixbytes without explicit row packing.

Let P and N be weighted bone-transformed position/normal. V0=normalize(P-camera); Ppush=P+V0*depthPush; clip[row]=dot([Ppush,1],projectionRow). Rim facing=clamp(dot(normalize(camera-Ppush),normalize(N)),0,1); rim=(1-powr(facing,vFresnel.w))*vFresnel.rgb. Depth push therefore changes rim direction as well as clipposition. Nonzero normal and camera separation are required even when depthPush0.

Bind PS34 buffer16 size32: erosionParams(t,s,a,b)@0, mixer@16. Textures0remap,1erosion,2base; samplers0erosion,1base,15shared. Explicit1x1 remapalpha0 disables remapreplacement. Example erosiontextureR=.5,mixer[1,0,0,0],params[.5,1,1,1] makes erosion alphafactor1. Base/tint/rim/mappedpower/matrices remain explicit synthetic inputs.

PS34 uses tint*base, conditional remapRGB, plusrim*base.a beforeRGBclamp. Outputalpha=tint.a*base.a*erosionFactor. No cube/lookup/FOW/alpha-test resource/instruction appears in this exact program. Other permutations require their own ABI; do not transferPS11lookupslots.
